outcome: shivering lasting between 30 minutes and one hour
shivering lasting more than one hour (duration of shivering)
cohort: The study included a sample of 597 pregnant women.
finding: Severity and duration of postpartum shivering were associated with rupture of membranes (spontaneous or artificial), fever, caesarean section, and oxytocin infusion.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with both the severity and duration of postpartum shivering.
